description: This file defines the CommandLine class used for building and parsing command line arguments, including handling switches, arguments, and singleton initialization for the current process.

classes.name: base::CommandLine
classes.description: A class for constructing, parsing, and managing command line arguments and switches, with platform-specific handling for Windows and POSIX systems.

methods.name: StringTypeToUTF8
methods.description: Converts platform-specific string type to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: UTF8ToStringType
methods.description: Converts UTF-8 string to platform-specific string type.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the singleton CommandLine for the current process with argc and argv.

methods.name: ForCurrentProcess
methods.description: Returns the singleton CommandLine instance for the current process.

methods.name: GetCommandLineString
methods.description: Constructs the command line string from the arguments.

methods.name: HasSwitch
methods.description: Checks if a switch is present in the command line.

methods.name: GetSwitchValueString
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a switch.

methods.name: AppendSwitch
methods.description: Adds a switch with optional value to the command line.
